profile.headline: AI Engineer @ Google
profile.summary:
"Don't let schooling interfere with your education," Mark Twain once said. As an Applied and Computational Mathematics major at Brigham Young University, this quote has been a driving influence in life. I am passionate about education and enjoy working with others. My education at BYU along with research experience have brought me to love solving complicated problems, work cohesively in group projects, and become a better-equipped person to make a difference in the world. I have developed these skills through experience including:

->Modeling & Simulations Engineer
In several system engineering teams, I have generated and analyzed data from probabilistic models using high-performance resources and machine learning methods. I have also presented much of my findings at internal and external briefings.

->Mathematics Research Assistant
I model collagen lattices using C++ and MATLAB shedding light on collagen biomechanics. I also am training another research assistant in programming principles and collagen biomechanics.

->ANOVA Project Team Member
Working in a team, I computed correlations between foreign language acquisition, serving LDS missions, and academic success using R-Studio and ANOVA statistical models.

->Team Member for Analyzing Methods for Approximating Pi
Also in a team, I develop efficient algorithms for approximating Pi and statistically analyzed the effectiveness
of these methods using Excel. Our team won first place at the Utah Science and Engineering Fair twice, and was awarded two scholarships through the BYU Mathematics Department.

->Two-Year Full-Time Representative for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints in the Philippines
I served in leadership positions for 13 of the 24 months, and mentored over 25 volunteers. Worked an 80-hour work week dedicated to customer-service. As a result, I am fluent in Tagalog oral communication, reading, writing, and interpreting.

I am also a passionate piano performer and accompanist, pole vaulter, vocalist, and enjoy hiking, mountain biking, snowboarding, gymnastics, and studying foreign languages. I am also competent in conversational Spanish.
